verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents in-product AI that analyzes the user's own data: Sprinto AI validates uploaded audit evidence and flags gaps such as outdated timestamps or irrelevant screenshots, and it offers AI-assisted due diligence reviews. These are scoped point features rather than a broad insight layer, and nothing independent confirms they work. Missing for 10: general AI-generated insights or recommendations across compliance posture, risks and dashboards; detail on what the AI-assisted due diligence produces; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Sprinto AI analyses your submission and flags gaps such as outdated timestamps or irrelevant screenshots — allowing you to correct them before audit time.
Use Sprinto AI to automatically validate your uploaded evidence for relevance, scope, and timeliness before audit submission.
Sprinto supports both manual and AI-assisted due diligence reviews.
